decisions.reason: Transactional email is featured on the home page and extends the core messaging infrastructure at low marginal cost, so it is a strategic option worth keeping and expanding.
Managed capture shows a concrete customer reference and fits the digital document workflow direction, so its value is being realized and justifies continued commitment.
Email and fax conversion reuses existing fax and email platforms at little cost and serves regulated customers who still need fax, so keeping the option open is cheap.
This feature is embedded in the established fax service and costs little to maintain, although declining fax use limits its upside.
Sandbox threat protection addresses growing security demand within the email security suite, and unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner it offers differentiated value.
